text:
mike: Quick flag — dashboard anomaly after the launch push, looks like UTM mismatch for webinar signups. pulling reports now

sarah: saw it, thanks. do we have funnel deltas yet?

mike: top-level: form conversions down ~18% vs forecast, but demo requests up ~4%. source mix flipped to 'Direct' for a chunk of sessions

anya: hm. pinging @oliver for attribution mapping — could be a redirect stripping params from the gated PDF download

oliver: quick check: the PDF redirect is via our CDN and the querystring isn't forwarded. example from access log: `GET /pdf/gated?utm_campaign=launchA&utm_source=email` -> `302 /pdf/gated-download` (no querystring)

mike: that'd make GA attribute those sessions as Direct if utm params missing

anya: can we implement a Looker fallback that uses landing_page_path when UTM missing? should recover channel attribution for historical cohorts

oliver: added a LookML dimension `channel_fallback` that prefers utm_campaign/utm_source then falls back to landing_page_path. testing in staging now. snippet:
```
dimension: channel_fallback {
  sql: COALESCE(${TABLE}.utm_source, NULLIF(${TABLE}.landing_page_path, '')) ;;
}
```

mike: nice. deploy when green. also: re-run the weekly cohort queries after deploy so we can compare pre/post in tomorrow's KPI review

deploy-bot: deploy 2154321124 SUCCESS — LookML model v3.2.1 deployed by oliver :rocket:

oliver: pushed to prod, jobs kicked off. pulling before/after tables now

mike: re-ran the cohort. quick numbers: total leads unchanged; Direct down 16pp, Content/Organic up ~12pp combined, net webinar leads unchanged. will paste full table in #marketing-dash later

anya: for the weekly KPI deck I'll add an "Attribution correction" slide with: what happened, affected metrics, and recommended wording. draft phrasing: "Query-param stripping on the gated PDF redirect caused ~18% of webinar leads to be misattributed to Direct. Applying a landing-page fallback restores historical channel mix. No change to total leads; refactors channel percentages."

sarah: that wording works. please include the raw before/after table and the LookML change link. we'll call it out in the KPI review tomorrow at 10:30 PT

mike: uploading the CSV snapshot now -> https://redwood.internal/snapshots/2154321135/webinar_cohort_prepost.csv

anya: added slide + screenshot of the LookML diff. will queue an agenda item for the 10:30 sync to explain impact and next steps (update downstream dashboards, note in weekly recap)

sarah: great work. lesson: add redirect tests to the launch checklist so UTM forwarding is validated before gated assets go live

mike: agreed. adding checklist item now. :white_check_mark:

oliver: FYI I'll also open a small infra ticket to have the CDN preserve querystrings on our redirect route by default

anya: awesome — that'll prevent similar incidents. thanks team :pray:

mike: thanks all. see you at 10:30. :thumbsup:
